name: Shoutmon (King Version)
main_effect:
＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.)
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
[On Deletion] You may place 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart], [Blue Flare] or [Hero] trait from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers. Then, ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
